component.name: OpenTrader
component.summary: Desktop market charting, screening and technical analysis

description.p: OpenTrader is a desktop application for market charts and research. It includes technical indicators, screeners, backtesting, bar replay, drawing tools, alerts and scripting.
Market data is currently delayed by 15 minutes. OpenTrader is for charting and research and is not financial advice.

Community sign-in and proxy passwords are kept only for the current session unless OpenTrader can use your desktop's Secret Service. To allow storage across launches, run flatpak override --user --talk-name=org.freedesktop.secrets com.opentrader.app. Remove this permission with flatpak override --user --no-talk-name=org.freedesktop.secrets com.opentrader.app.
